answer: PUF-bound acoustic time-of-flight attestation: each agent carries a tamper-evident chip whose ferrous microstructure yields a unique challenge-response; a local beacon signs nonces and measures ultrasonic round-trip timing. The chip signs the nonce only if its PUF matches, and timing binds the response to a distinct physical endpoint—even across a hollow river canyon or noisy site. A Sybil operator must buy and place one unclonable device per identity and maintain separate ranging paths; cloning needs invasive microprobing, and virtual clones fail timing/PUF binding.
